Apple One bundles multiple popular Apple services at a discount, and the high-tier Premier plan will receive a new advantage in iOS 27.

Apple One Premier will get two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence

If you're an Apple One user looking for a reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 might just give you one.

The new iPhone operating system software introduces two upgrades for the high-tier Apple One plan.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Increased image generation usage limits and other features

Apple's Home app will gain various AI features in iOS 27, some of which will only be available to users subscribed to the 2TB iCloud+ plan—meaning you'll need Apple One Premier or the highest standalone iCloud+ plan to access them.

It remains unclear whether all or only some of the AI features will require a subscription. The iOS 27 beta release notes simply state: "Apple Intelligence in Home requires an iCloud+ plan of 2TB or higher."

However, it's almost certain that the HomeKit Secure Video upgrades will require the high-tier plan, including automatic video descriptions, video clip search, and automatic flagging of notable clips.

If you need a camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video, here are our recommendations:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: from $35, a great value pick
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K resolution, priced higher, from $59

In addition, some new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) come with daily usage limits. Apple says Apple One Premier subscribers will enjoy higher usage limits:

The iCloud+ plan included with the Apple One "Individual" tier does not qualify. So if you want higher AI usage limits, that's another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and includes services like Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
